services.name: Go-Kart Racing
services.desc: Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping adventure at Adventure Coast Fun Park’s go-kart track! Perfect for families, friends, and racing enthusiasts, our go-karting experience offers the perfect blend of excitement and competition approximately 8-10 laps (5 min) on a 1000ft race track. Restrictions: Drivers must be 52"

variants.label: Mine for gems, minerals, fossils, and arrowheads; 3oz minimum per bag

includes: Equipment for batting cages (helmets/bats) at no additional cost
Host provided for birthday parties to manage flow and assist guests
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy go-kart racing on a 1000ft track, play on a newly renovated 18-hole mini golf course, use batting cages with various speed options, mine for gems and fossils, and play arcade games. The park offers single ticket and wristband pricing, with no admission fee. Private events and birthday parties are available with hosts to assist.
extraNote: Parking and admission are always free; only pay to play · 3% surcharge on all credit card transactions · No deposit required to reserve birthday parties or for walk-in guests · Recommended to arrive a few minutes early for party check-in · Adventure Coast Fun Park, 9227 County Line Rd, Spring Hill, FL 34606
